IMAGE PROMPT
An original young woman with soft, pale auburn
hair and a white knit beret with a flower accent
stands against a soft beige backdrop. She wears a
chunky red cable-knit sweater with an off-shoulder
drop and a black bow tie at one shoulder. A dark
denim mermaid skirt with a frayed asymmetric hem
and a patch sits beneath, with a red plaid scarf
draped over one arm. Brown chunky loafers and
white socks complete the look. Her expression is
calm and direct. Soft, even studio light. Palette of
crimson, indigo denim, and cream. Cozy and
festive, in the style of a winter knitwear catalog.
